statement: A restarted-node recovery timeout that is bootstrap-reachable but pre-admin preserves the direct target's own infrastructure-join phase, lifecycle state, checkpoint target, ready-signal gate, attempt, and last retryable failure in the startup-runtime handoff and terminal failure barrier, so restart_infrastructure_join distinguishes the stalled owner boundary without treating missing evidence, bootstrap reachability, or admin refusal as cause.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Project process-local progress only. Do not change startup ordering, timers, retry budgets, admission or readiness predicates, recovery activation, bootstrap routing, load, cleanup, or durable checkpoint advancement.

Reuse NodeJoiningService phase, lifecycle state, checkpoint execution, ready-signal flow, startupRuntimeHandoff, readiness-probe normalization, timeout formatter, failure barrier, and stability gate. Do not add a readiness, joining, recovery, retry, or diagnostic polling owner.

The direct target must distinguish CDC subscription readiness, local-query transport, metadata publication, cold-formation eligibility, and heartbeat publication in their existing execution order, including bounded attempt and last retryable failure where that owner already retries.

Retain structured own-data fields through the readiness probe and terminal failure bundle; preserve null/unknown honestly for legacy or incomplete observations, reject inherited/accessor fabrication, and never infer a gate from admin refusal or text-only logs.

A deterministic fixture matching the retained N=1 shape (durable_rejoin, bootstrap reachable, admin refused, control-plane recovery ready, infrastructure join incomplete, canonical authority unconsumed, transaction recovery not_started) must classify the exact witnessed join progress when present and remain only restart_infrastructure_join with unknown sub-boundary when absent.
Deterministic tests must fail when the join progress producer or any projection hop is reverted while retaining the prior coarse infrastructure-join classification.
Run the existing model-contract gate for adjacency. Do not extend TLA+ or Alloy unless implementation changes lifecycle, retry, checkpoint, or owner-cardinality semantics beyond evidence projection.

After deterministic closure and independent verification on one exact clean commit, run at most one unchanged N=1 rolling-restart engagement to identify the live join sub-boundary. Do not start an N=15 certification window in this child Quest.
